title: Quick Savory Japanese Tofu Shoyu Ramen
description: A savory and quick-fix Japanese dish featuring Italian seasoning and stir-fry, made vegan-friendly in a ramen-shoyu form.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and stir-fry until it is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and stir-fry until they are tender.
Add the Italian seasoning to the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the shoyu sauce to the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the extra firm tofu to the skillet and stir-fry until it is golden brown.
Drain the cooked ramen noodles and add them to the skillet.
Stir-fry all the ingredients together for 2 minutes.
Transfer the ramen to a bowl and garnish with chopped green onions.
